poem.content:
In the summer of ICOs, a million wallets bloomed
Truly, a garden of promise, where visions were assumed
A dial ticked forward, a countdown to the dawn
Of a new era, where cryptocurrency took on form

But like a lock, secrets were kept, hidden behind a mask
Investors oblige, with questions unasked
The liquid gold of speculation flowed, a tidal wave's crash
As prices rose and fell, a precarious dance of hash

In this market of mirrors, a photo of reality gleams
A world of ethics questioned, where honesty falters in dreams
Injury to the wallet, a story oft retold
Of losses incurred, of dreams that grew old

But some still wish to hop on the wave, to ride the crest
A fleeting joy, a thrill that will forever rest
In the memories of a day, when fortunes were made and unmade
When summer sunshine gleamed on the market's fragile trade

But now the news arrives, a forthright call to pay
The costs of speculation, the damage done each day
The balance sheet shows, a ledger of regret
A tally of the losses, the lessons yet to be learned and set

In the wake of the storm, a reflection of what's true
A world of promises made, and the ethics we pursue
A link to a brighter past, a path yet untold
A summer's tale of blockchain's wild and troubled hold

In the end, it's not just profit, nor the way we play
But the people, the communities, that bridge the way
For in the wave of change, a new dawn must arise
When ethics and liquidity meet, in the summer's bright surprise.
